About me

Hello! My name is Oscar and I'm looking forward to turning my life around, radically changing my my life, changing radically my job sector, going from the audiovisual to the audiovisual world to the technological one. Since I was a child, technology and and hardware have attracted me (computers and videogames, as well as different tech different tech products), so although I'm just starting out in the world of programming in the world of programming, it is clear to me that I will find a branch that branch that I am passionate about and in which I can grow professionally.

I think one of the characteristics that best defines me is my ability to work in a team. I am also curious, which motivates me to keep learning and exploring new technologies.

My goal is to continue to develop in the programming field and take advantage of the opportunities that the technology sector has to offer, always looking to learn and grow in each project.
